blurb: Guests fish on the Chesapeake Bay aboard the Miss Edie, a 38 foot custom built Chesapeake Bay Deadrise boat. Captain Mike, a licensed charter boat captain with over fifty years experience, leads trips for up to 6 passengers. The boat is equipped with modern electronics, cabin with head, hot and cold water, and a roofed deck for comfort and safety.
extraNote: Guests leave from the dock in Captain Mike's front yard, near the high tide line on Chesapeake Bay. · Striper fishing season begins in April and runs through at least December (based on reports).
